entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.191/2023 dated 24.03.2023 registered at Police Station Kundipura, District Chhindwara for the offence under Sections 376(A)(B),
376(2)(h), 376(2)(J) and 376 of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5(m), 5(n) and 6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
She further submits that applicant is an old aged man and he is aged about 67 years.
Investigation is complete and charge-sheet has been filed.
Applicant does not have criminal past.

The applicant is in custody since 24.03.2023 and trial will take considerable Heeralal Sahu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128597654/
1 time to conclude.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that applicant is permanent resident of district and there is no likelihood of his absconding from the clutches of law or tamper with prosecution evidence.
He also submits that the applicant is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the directions and conditions which may be imposed by this Hon'ble Court.
Upon these grounds, the applicant may be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
The prosecution case is that the applicant committed rape on his granddaughter who was aged less than 10 years at the time of the incident.
The birth certificate of the prosecutrix seized in the matter gives corroboration to her alleged age.
Her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. supports the prosecution version.
DNA report is awaited from FSL.

Though the applicant has raised the ground of enmity on the basis of property dispute and has also questioned the delay caused in reporting the matter, but looking to the gravity of the crime and the relationship of applicant and prosecutrix, the bail application is dismissed.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE Nitesh Heeralal Sahu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128597654/
